title: Landing on Langkawi, Toes in the Sea
excerpt: I stepped off the AirAsia tarmac and within hours I was wading into the warm Andaman at Pantai Cenang, watching the sun melt into the horizon.

photos.alt: Passengers walking across the open tarmac at Langkawi Airport, an AirAsia jet parked behind them beneath dramatic tropical clouds and a forested hill
Colourful 'Pantai Chenang' landmark sign on a decorative white wall, with palm trees and the beach visible behind it under a blue sky
Silhouette of a person crouching in the shallows at Pantai Cenang at golden hour, small islands and a jet-ski visible on the glittering horizon
Dome-moulded fried rice topped with crispy shallots and greens, surrounded by dark soy sauce and a side of stir-fried vegetables on a white plate
